posts.title: Get off sugar for a week and you’ll realize you don’t want it
posts.description: Sugar might be the most dominant drug of our age. Everything you buy has sugar in it. Over the last 10 years in our country, restaurant culture has become widely accepted. We’ve gone from family-cooked meals to outsourcing nutrition to profit-driven companies. That’s why sugary, unhealthy foods are everywhere . posts.title: YON - your free note taking and also sharing app
posts.description: I needed a writing tool that was web-native, bloat-free, and accessible from any device. So I built YON with Lovable. It is a private space where your notes are organized into playlists for clarity. You can import your old markdown (.txt or .md) files instantly or share your note via a simple URL. There is no installation required and no tracking involved. Try it: yon-otw.lovable.app

posts.title: Two Things Sameness Causes
posts.description: If you're doing the same thing everyone else is doing, you will not be hard to compete with. If what you do can be done by someone else, it eventually will be, and for less money.
